name: Joachim Lang
headline: Exit Readiness. Anytime. As transparency is key for high valuation and transaction security.
summary:
We offer successful planning, exit preparation and hands-on support for PE Portfolio companies especially in the period 1-2 years upfront a planned exit. We support you e.g., in setting up relevant data basis or self-BI solution, calculations and analysis as well as with the optimisation of Controlling & Accounting processes. In addition, we help you also in intense time during the Due Diligence & Exit Process.

Our core believe is that TRANSPARENCY provided through
•	well-thought continuous structuring of given data, 
•	the transparent visualization of information, 
•	the enduring cleaning of master data and the continuous data driven analysis and 
•	the continuous training of your staff in new skills on handling of large data sets and meaningful analysis 
is the outmost value enhancing driver for not only for a successful exit or M&A process and is also the basis of a meaningful management of a company.

How we work:
We work as a SUPPLEMENT to your business. We do not re-explain your business and tell you what you already know, but we are your proactive sparring partner and reliable team member to support but also to challenge you. 
You can expect 100 % dedication to your cause with an exceptional basket full of experience and Know How in Controlling, Process Design, Transaction / M&A and Data Management skills.

Free for your task starting from September 2022.
